title: Blue Crab Chesapeake Sailing Charters

services.name: Cruise Details
services.desc: Just $35.00 per person payable by cash or check at the dock! (Four pp minimum) Group rate is $210.00 for 5 or 6 passengers. Maximum of 6 passengers. Standard cruises are 90 minutes. Private, extended and custom cruises are also available. Management has the right to cancel or reschedule any cruise due to weather or other issue. There is no age restriction to sail. blurb: Providing sailing cruises 25 years in Rock Hall, Md, Blue Crab Charters provides an award winning experience that you won't want to miss! Take the helm or just relax as you set sail from Rock Hall Harbor into the open Chesapeake Bay or the scenic Swan Creek. Blue Crab Chesapeake Charters is home to Rock Hall's Original Sunset Cruise and will surely top off any visit to Maryland's Eastern Shore.
